figurative_meaning_en: Bond of affection or marital ties
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার প্রতি ভালোবাসায় পায়ের বেড়ী পরা হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: After getting married, I've put on the fetters of the feet.
My love for her has bound me like ankle shackles.
note: Refers to the traditional concept of marriage as a loving constraint in Bengali society.
